pool.text: North West Company established Fort William as its mid-continent entrepôt.
French-speaking Jesuits established Mission of the Immaculate Conception on the Kaministiquia.
Province of Canada negotiated Robinson Treaty with the Ojibwa of Lake Superior.
Canadian Pacific Railway renamed Prince Arthur's Landing to Port Arthur.
Port Arthur built Canada's first municipally owned electric street railway.
Both cities spurned Bell Telephone Company to establish municipally owned telephone systems.
Canada Car and Foundry Company plant re-opened to build British aircraft.
Thunder Bay Symphony Orchestra was founded as the only professional orchestra between Winnipeg and Toronto.
The City of Thunder Bay was formed through merging municipalities.
Thunder Bay's flag was created by mayor Saul Laskin to promote the city.
Thunder Bay Art Gallery was founded, specializing in First Nations artists.
Thunder Bay hosted the Summer Canada Games.
NOSFA was established to feature monthly screenings of international and Canadian films.
Thunder Bay hosted the Nordic World Ski Championships.
Northwestern Ontario Writers Workshop was founded to promote writers and literature.
The city of Thunder Bay was declared a Cultural Capital of Canada.
Vox Popular Media Arts Festival was established as an independent film festival.
Northwestern Ontario Aviation Heritage Centre was founded to celebrate aviation history.
Thunder Pride LGBTQ pride parade has been held annually since this year.
Alstom acquired the facility from Bombardier.
